name: tonir
description: Tonir: an Issues pane that follows the repo you are working in, with a one-press Build pipeline, and a live Agents pane with step progress, context, cost and time.

isolation.title: Build isolation
isolation.description: worktree: a build runs in its own git worktree and never touches your checkout. none: it works in the session's folder.

leadModel.title: Build lead model
leadModel.description: The model of the agent that leads a build; inherit uses the session's model.

coderAgent.title: Coder agent
coderAgent.description: Agent type that writes the code; general-purpose is used when no such type exists.

validatorAgent.title: Validator agent
validatorAgent.description: Agent type that reviews the change; general-purpose is used when no such type exists.

trustedAuthors.title: Whose issues can be built
trustedAuthors.description: members: owner, members and collaborators of the repo. owner: the repo owner only. anyone: every author.

blockedFolders.title: Blocked folders
blockedFolders.description: Folder names, separated by commas, that Tonir never reads, lists or builds in (matched on any part of a path).

buildInstructions.title: Build instructions
buildInstructions.description: Extra rules added to every build lead's prompt, under 'Project rules from the person'.

autoOpenAgents.title: Open Tonir on agents
autoOpenAgents.description: on-spawn: open Tonir when an agent starts after a quiet spell. never: only when you ask.

openBar.title: Bar above the prompt
openBar.description: on: one row above the prompt with the open count and buttons for the Issues and Agents panes.
